composition_variation: Create an original premium 2D anime wallpaper of exactly one woman, visibly 26 years old, with soft mint-green hair in a rounded chin-length bob with one side tucked neatly behind her ear. She has mature, self-assured elegance and realistic adult proportions. Use large but adult-proportioned jade eyes, a delicate jawline, a small straight nose, and an affectionate focused expression. Her opaque dove-gray sleeveless collared summer dress falls below the knees, with a simple narrow fabric belt and practical flat sandals. She holds a small cream watering can close to her waist and pours a fine stream onto a potted fern directly beside her. Slender glasshouse ribs, rounded fern fronds, and one translucent-looking glass ornament form restrained details at the edges. Lavender evening shadows and a faint teal aurora outside the glass add dreamlike color without overwhelming her face. Frame at eye level for a very tall phone crop. Keep her face, body, and hands inside the central narrow column, in the middle and lower image; leave the upper 25% calm and mostly empty for the clock. Natural nonsexual posture, opaque summer clothing, graceful anatomy, small readable hands close to her body. Refined linework, layered cel shading, painterly light, no text, logos, other people, or copied characters.
